import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json,base64
W=str(Path('write_lane.py').resolve())
t=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/chess-final2020.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',W,'sources/chess-final2020.txt'],input=t,text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
a=t.find('Theorem 3.2.');b=t.find('4',a+3000);print(t[a:a+4800])
